name: Arjun Mehta
bio_note: Hero persona. Gujarati family settled in Kolkata for three generations; moving to Bangalore next year.

aspects.statement: Family comes first, but he wants a partner with her own ambitions, not someone who just fits in.
aspects.evidence: "My parents matter a lot to me, but I don't want someone who just fits in — I want someone with her own thing going on."

aspects.statement: Values honesty and keeping promises over grand gestures.
aspects.evidence: "I'd rather someone tell me a hard truth than make a big romantic speech."

aspects.statement: Lives in a joint family in Kolkata with his parents and grandmother; very close to his dadi.
aspects.evidence: "It's me, my parents and my dadi at home. Dadi and I watch cricket together every match."

aspects.statement: Moving to Bangalore next year; the role is confirmed. Parents may visit for long stretches.
aspects.evidence: "I'm moving to Bangalore next year, the transfer is already confirmed."

aspects.statement: Wants to lead an engineering team within three years; works steady hours and protects weekends.
aspects.evidence: "I want to be managing a team by 31, but I don't do the 2 a.m. startup thing."

aspects.statement: Early riser; plays football every Sunday morning; enjoys cooking Gujarati food for the family.
aspects.evidence: "Sunday mornings are football, non-negotiable. Then I make thepla for everyone."

aspects.statement: Into cricket, trekking in the Himalayas, and old Hindi film music.
aspects.evidence: "I did the Sandakphu trek last year and I want to do one every year."

aspects.statement: Cools off briefly in a disagreement, then talks it through the same day; dislikes silent treatment.
aspects.evidence: "I need ten minutes to cool down, but I won't go to sleep angry."

aspects.statement: Culturally Hindu; celebrates festivals with family but is not ritualistic.
aspects.evidence: "Diwali and Navratri are big at home, but I'm not someone who does daily puja."

aspects.statement: Sends money to his parents every month and is still repaying an education loan.
aspects.evidence: "I send money home every month and I still have about two years left on my education loan."

aspects.statement: Hopes his partner would be open to living with his parents for the first year of marriage.
aspects.evidence: "Ideally for the first year we'd stay with my parents, so they get to know her."

aspects.statement: Wants a partner who is independent, curious and warm with elders.
aspects.evidence: "Someone who'd chat with my dadi but also has strong opinions of her own."

aspects.statement: Will not consider a partner who smokes.
aspects.evidence: "Smoking is a hard no for me. My grandfather had lung problems."

name: Meera Sen
bio_note: Hero persona. Bengali family in Kolkata; moved to Bangalore for work four years ago.

aspects.statement: Close to her family, and equally committed to her own career and independence.
aspects.evidence: "I call my parents every day, but I also built my life here on my own."

aspects.statement: Prizes honesty and direct conversations; dislikes games.
aspects.evidence: "Just tell me what you think. I can handle anything except guessing."

aspects.statement: Parents and younger brother live in Kolkata; the family is warm and traditional about festivals.
aspects.evidence: "Durga Puja at home is the one week I never miss."

aspects.statement: Settled in Bangalore and wants to stay; open to Kolkata only in the long term.
aspects.evidence: "Bangalore is home now. Maybe Kolkata when we're older, near my parents."

aspects.statement: Senior product designer aiming to lead a design team; career is central to who she is.
aspects.evidence: "I want to head design somewhere in the next few years."

aspects.statement: Early starts, studio by 9, and evenings for sketching and long walks; hikes on weekends.
aspects.evidence: "Evenings are for sketching. Weekends I try to get out of the city and hike."

aspects.statement: Sketching, hiking in the Western Ghats, Rabindra Sangeet and street food.
aspects.evidence: "Give me a trail and a plate of puchka after and I'm happy."

aspects.statement: Talks things through the same day; needs a partner who doesn't go silent.
aspects.evidence: "The silent treatment is the worst. Let's just talk."

aspects.statement: Culturally Hindu and festival-loving, not ritualistic.
aspects.evidence: "I love the pujas for the food and family, honestly."

aspects.statement: Open to living with in-laws for a short time, with a clear plan for their own home after.
aspects.evidence: "A few months or a year with his parents is fine, as long as we know when we'll have our own place."

aspects.statement: Wants a steady, kind partner who is proud of her work.
aspects.evidence: "I want someone who brags about my work to his friends."

aspects.statement: Had a long relationship that ended last year; she is ready to move on but cautious.
aspects.evidence: "I was with someone for four years. It ended last year. I'm ready, just careful."

aspects.statement: Will not marry someone who expects her to give up or scale back her career.
aspects.evidence: "If he thinks I'll quit after marriage, that's the end of it."

aspects.statement: Does not want a partner who smokes.
aspects.evidence: "I can't do smoking."
